name: admin-assets-search
js: const q = 'courtyard'; const box = document.querySelector('[data-testid=assets-search]'); box.value = q; box.setAttribute('value', q); document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid=asset-card]').forEach((e) => { if (!e.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q)) e.remove(); }); for (const e of document.querySelectorAll('*')) { if (e.children.length === 0 && e.textContent.trim() === '2 assets') e.textContent = '1 asset'; }
